preconditions.description: The length of the word s is between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(c.isalpha() and c.isascii() for c in s)
preconditions.description: The word s consists of uppercase and lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The corrected word is either all lowercase or all uppercase.

postconditions.expression: sum(1 for c in s if c.isupper()) > sum(1 for c in s if c.islower()) if return_value.isupper() else sum(1 for c in s if c.isupper()) <= sum(1 for c in s if c.islower())
postconditions.description: The corrected word is in uppercase if there are more uppercase letters in the original word, otherwise it is in lowercase.
